description: Sprint 7 - Persistent Glossary, Batch Bubble Editing, Version History, Confidence Indicator. All four features implemented together in a single coherent commit.
steps: Step 1 - Create branch: git checkout -b feature/alpha-sprint7 from current HEAD (feature/alpha-sprint6)

Step 2 - Glossary Store: Create store/useGlossaryStore.ts with Zustand persisted store containing entries: { id: string, source: string, target: string, caseSensitive: boolean }[], and actions: addEntry, removeEntry, updateEntry, clearAll, importCSV, exportCSV. Use zustand persist middleware with localStorage key 'glossary-store'.
Step 3 - Export Glossary from barrel: Add useGlossaryStore export to store/index.ts

Step 4 - GlossaryPanel UI: Create features/settings/GlossaryPanel.tsx - a panel with a table showing source/target columns, add entry form, edit/delete buttons, import CSV button (file input), export CSV button. Include case-sensitive toggle per entry.
Step 5 - Add Glossary tab to SettingsPanel: In features/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx, add a 4th tab 'Glossario' to the TabId type and tabs array. Render GlossaryPanel when activeTab === 'glossario'.

Step 6 - Backend glossary support: In backend/app/schemas/pipeline.py, add 'glossary: list[GlossaryEntry] = []' to PipelineOptions. Create GlossaryEntry as a CamelModel with source: str, target: str fields.

Step 7 - Gemini provider glossary: In backend/app/providers/gemini.py, modify process_manga_page and translate_bubbles to accept an optional glossary parameter (list of dicts with source/target). When non-empty, append glossary instructions to the prompt: 'GLOSSARY - Use these EXACT translations for the following terms: [source] = [target], ...'

Step 8 - OpenAI provider glossary: In backend/app/providers/openai.py, modify process_manga_page and translate_bubbles to accept an optional glossary parameter. When non-empty, append the same glossary instructions to the prompt.

Step 9 - Pipeline service glossary passthrough: In backend/app/services/pipeline.py, pass req.options.glossary to the Gemini and OpenAI OCR/translate functions (_run_gemini_ocr, _run_openai_ocr, _run_translation_step).
Step 10 - Frontend PipelineOptions glossary: In services/api/pipelineApi.ts, add 'glossary?: { source: string; target: string }[]' to PipelineOptions interface.

Step 11 - useTranslatePipeline glossary integration: In features/translator/useTranslatePipeline.ts, import useGlossaryStore. In the runPipeline and runPipelineOcrOnly and runPipelineTranslateOnly internal functions, read glossary entries from useGlossaryStore.getState().entries and pass them as options.glossary in the pipeline request.

Step 12 - Batch Bubble Editing: In components/MangaViewer.tsx, add state: selectedBubbleIds: string[]. Add Ctrl+Click handler on BubbleOverlay to toggle selection (add/remove from selectedBubbleIds). Selected bubbles get a blue ring highlight (pass isSelected prop to BubbleOverlay). When 2+ bubbles selected, show a BatchBubbleToolbar component.

Step 13 - BubbleOverlay multi-select: Add optional props to BubbleOverlay: isSelected?: boolean, onCtrlClick?: (bubbleId: string) => void. When isSelected, show a blue ring (ring-2 ring-blue-500). On click with ctrl/meta key pressed, call onCtrlClick instead of normal click behavior.

Step 14 - BatchBubbleToolbar component: Create components/BatchBubbleToolbar.tsx. Shows when 2+ bubbles selected. Contains: font selector dropdown, bold toggle, italic toggle, font size +/- buttons, delete all button. Each action loops through selectedBubbleIds, calls pushBubbleSnapshot once, then updates each bubble. Takes props: selectedIds, bubbles, allFonts, onUpdate, onDelete, onClear (clears selection).

Step 15 - Version History: In store/useSessionStore.ts, add translationVersions: Record<string, { timestamp: number, bubbles: TextBubble[], translatedImageUrl?: string }[]> to SessionState. Add actions: saveVersion(imageId), restoreVersion(imageId, index). saveVersion captures current bubbles/translatedImageUrl, max 5 per image (FIFO). This is in-memory only (not persisted).

Step 16 - Save version before retranslation: In features/translator/useTranslatePipeline.ts, before handleRetranslate clears the image state, call useSessionStore.getState().saveVersion(imageId) to preserve the current translation.

Step 17 - Version History UI: In components/MangaViewer.tsx (or a small sub-component), add a 'Versoes' dropdown button in the toolbar area (only visible when versions exist for current image). Clicking a version entry calls restoreVersion to swap bubbles back. Show timestamp formatted as HH:mm.
Step 18 - Confidence Indicator type: In types.ts, add optional 'confidence?: number' field (0-1) to TextBubble interface.
Step 19 - Backend confidence field: In backend/app/schemas/common.py, add optional confidence: float | None = None to TextBubble model.

Step 20 - BubbleOverlay confidence dot: In components/BubbleOverlay.tsx, when bubble.confidence is defined and < 0.7, show a small orange dot (w-2 h-2 bg-orange-500 rounded-full) at the top-right corner of the bubble.
Step 21 - Gemini OCR confidence prompt: In backend/app/providers/gemini.py, add 'confidence' (type: NUMBER, 0-1) to the _BUBBLE_SCHEMA items properties and update _bubble_from_raw to extract it.
Step 22 - OpenAI OCR confidence prompt: In backend/app/providers/openai.py, add confidence field to the OCR prompt JSON schema request and update _bubble_from_raw to extract it.
Step 23 - Run npm run typecheck && npm run build to verify everything compiles cleanly.
Step 24 - Commit all changes with message 'feat: sprint 7 - glossary, batch editing, version history, confidence indicator'. Push to origin feature/alpha-sprint7.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with no errors
New store/useGlossaryStore.ts exists with persist middleware
SettingsPanel has a 4th tab 'Glossario' rendering GlossaryPanel
Gemini and OpenAI providers accept and use glossary in prompts
useTranslatePipeline passes glossary entries to pipeline request
MangaViewer supports Ctrl+Click multi-select with blue highlight
Version history dropdown shows in MangaViewer toolbar when versions exist
TextBubble type has optional confidence field
BubbleOverlay shows orange dot when confidence < 0.7
Branch feature/alpha-sprint7 is pushed to origin
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run build
findings: All features implemented and verified. Typecheck and build pass cleanly. No test failures. The VersionEntry type is exported from the store barrel and imported in MangaViewer directly from the module to avoid circular dependency issues.
